description: Implementation of the FramebufferD3D class for Direct3D rendering in ANGLE, including methods for clearing buffers, reading pixels, blitting, and managing attachments.

classes.name: FramebufferD3D
classes.description: A class implementing framebuffer operations for Direct3D in ANGLE, including buffer clearing, reading, blitting, and attachment management.

classes.name: ClearParameters
classes.description: A struct holding parameters for clearing framebuffer buffers.

methods.name: clear
methods.description: Clears the framebuffer buffers specified by the mask.

methods.name: clearBufferfv
methods.description: Clears a color or depth buffer with floating point values.

methods.name: clearBufferuiv
methods.description: Clears a color buffer with unsigned integer values.

methods.name: clearBufferiv
methods.description: Clears a color or stencil buffer with integer values.

methods.name: clearBufferfi
methods.description: Clears depth and stencil buffers with specified values.

methods.name: getImplementationColorReadFormat
methods.description: Returns the format used for reading pixels from the framebuffer.

methods.name: getImplementationColorReadType
methods.description: Returns the data type used for reading pixels from the framebuffer.

methods.name: readPixels
methods.description: Reads pixel data from the framebuffer within a specified area.

methods.name: blit
methods.description: Performs a blit operation between framebuffers.

methods.name: checkStatus
methods.description: Checks if the framebuffer is complete and valid for rendering.

methods.name: syncState
methods.description: Synchronizes the framebuffer state with the current GL state.

methods.name: getColorAttachmentsForRender
methods.description: Retrieves the list of color attachments for rendering.

methods.name: destroy
methods.description: Destroys the framebuffer and releases resources.
